diagnosis.cause: pnpm-lock.yaml line 1 declares lockfileVersion '6.0' (written by pnpm v8), but package.json has no 'packageManager' field, so Corepack downloads pnpm 12.6.0 which only supports lockfile formats ≥9 and rejects the existing lockfile.

doc.text: Before running `pnpm install`, pin the pnpm version that matches the lockfile by adding `"packageManager": "pnpm@8.15.9"` to package.json (or run `corepack use pnpm@8` once after `corepack enable`). The committed pnpm-lock.yaml uses lockfileVersion 6.0, which is only compatible with pnpm v8; newer pnpm versions (v9+) use lockfile format v9 and refuse to read it.
